descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Are you passionate about delivering best in class Client Experience? Do you enjoy identifying the most effective and efficient approaches for Wealth Management business? Are you good at constructively challenging business stakeholders around you? We’re looking for someone like that to:
• – Understand the processes; ensure adherence to regulations, guidelines, standards and UBS policies.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services
• – Be a key support pillar to ensure successful delivery of a major regulatory-driven Program
